title: no photo in 12h while the render request was refused 2x

notes.note: 2026-09-20 06:4xZ ops-triage: ROOT CAUSE FIXED in-repo (commit pending). The recovery path (Growth::RenderSalvage) lived at the top of CadenceEngine#sync, and the growth tick skips its whole cadence step when it cannot acquire the 4090 -- the right call for RENDERING, but it also gated the ONE path that needs no GPU. While a foreign claim held the card, every hourly tick was refused (comfyui_unclaimed 09-18/09-19/09-20) and three renders that had already been PAID FOR (runs 457/463/471, 2026-09-19 16:41-18:38) sat unposted on disk for 13h+ while the queue drained 21 -> 19. VERIFIED: 'Salvage: examined=2 recovered=2 posts=[342, 343] (shortfall=2)' -> queue 19->21 (at target), posts scheduled via PostSlotPlanner at 09-25/09-26 09:00Z with real captions (no placeholder), photos_12h 0->10; re-run prints 'skipped -- queue at target' (idempotent); full publisher run exits 0 with the new step. The check is now false because output resumed, NOT because contention ended: the 4090 is still held by prx-tg (foreign 1.5-96h claims) and the salvage reservoir is finite -- if refusals continue past the ~7-day queue runway this check will re-file and that is the correct escalation.
